title: Worker telemetry and pressure persistence
observed_behavior_before: domain.Worker had no raw telemetry or Bahia-derived pressure fields.
workers table had no telemetry or pressure JSONB columns.
PgWorkerRepository.Upsert updated an existing worker row on pubkey conflict without comparing advertisement timestamps.
intended_behavior: domain.Worker stores raw worker telemetry matching the Kind 10100 telemetry JSON shape.
domain.Worker stores Bahia-owned worker pressure assessment with pressure level, capacity class, action, per-signal detail, and assessment time.
workers rows persist telemetry and pressure JSONB fields.
Older worker advertisements do not overwrite newer worker rows.
